title: Feature Request - Additional options for "Number icon in notification area" feature
symptom: The issue is a feature request to add options for the number icon in the notification area, such as including the trend arrow and using colors to indicate below/in/above target range. The user also mentions that the status bar shows no xDrip symbol/number on their device.
evidence_quote: No color is possible in the status bar icon or on the always on display.
